description: This file defines Express.js route handlers related to user session management, including tenant listing, setting active tenants, and toggling tenant scope for authorization purposes.

methods.name: router.get('/tenants')
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list tenants accessible to the current user, with audit logging.

methods.name: router.post('/tenant')
methods.description: Handles POST requests to set an active tenant in the session, with RBAC validation, cookie setting, and audit logging.

methods.name: router.post('/tenants/select')
methods.description: An alias route for setting tenant, reusing the /tenant POST handler.

methods.name: router.post('/all-tenants')
methods.description: Allows a super admin to toggle a global tenant scope disabling filter, with audit logging.
